dialogues.jp: 今日は、やけに天気がいいな。
dialogues.en: Today looks like a good day.
dialogues.text: Today looks like a good day.

dialogues.jp:
俺は洗濯物をベランダに干す。この作業も、だ
んだん慣れてきた。
dialogues.en:
I started to hang my laundry out on the veranda. I'm slowly
getting used to chores like this.
dialogues.text:
I started to hang my laundry out on the veranda. I'm slowly
getting used to chores like this.

dialogues.jp:
今までは、音夢のいない不自由さを感じていた
が、一人も気楽でいいものだ。
dialogues.en:
There's still some discomfort with Nemu not being around,
but the bachelor life is enjoyable too.
dialogues.text:
There's still some discomfort with Nemu not being around,
but the bachelor life is enjoyable too.

dialogues.jp: 出かけるにしても、いちいち断らなくて済む。
dialogues.en:
One by one, they went up, until all the clothes were hung up
to dry.
dialogues.text:
One by one, they went up, until all the clothes were hung up
to dry.

dialogues.jp: 明日も、このぐらい天気が良いといいけど。
dialogues.en: Hopefully tomorrow's weather is as good as this.
dialogues.text: Hopefully tomorrow's weather is as good as this.

dialogues.jp: いよいよ、明日から巫女部の合宿が始まる。
dialogues.en:
Tomorrow's the start of the Miko Club training camp, after
all.
dialogues.text:
Tomorrow's the start of the Miko Club training camp, after
all.

dialogues.jp:
たった、１泊２日だし、近場の旅行だけど、そ
れなりに楽しみだ。
dialogues.en:
it may only be for two days, and to a fairly nearby place,
but it'd be fun all the same.
dialogues.text:
it may only be for two days, and to a fairly nearby place,
but it'd be fun all the same.

dialogues.jp:
ま、そんなことよりも、環といる方が数倍楽し
みなんだけど。
dialogues.en:
Of course, Tamaki's presence multiplies the fun factor by
several times.
dialogues.text:
Of course, Tamaki's presence multiplies the fun factor by
several times.

dialogues.jp: 一緒にいられる時間が短いからな。
dialogues.en: The time we've had together lately has been fleeting.
dialogues.text: The time we've had together lately has been fleeting.

dialogues.jp: 本当はもっと、色々なことを話したい。
dialogues.en: I wanted to talk to her, about everything and anything.
dialogues.text: I wanted to talk to her, about everything and anything.

dialogues.jp:
この間、さくらとうたまるが遊びに来たことと
か、まだ話してなかったよな。
dialogues.en:
I haven't told her about the escapades I've been having with
Sakura lately.
dialogues.text:
I haven't told her about the escapades I've been having with
Sakura lately.

dialogues.jp:
ひょっとしたら、さくらと二人でデートしたこ
と、やきもち妬くかな……。
dialogues.en:
Hmm, she might get jealous if she finds out Sakura and I
were on a date...
dialogues.text:
Hmm, she might get jealous if she finds out Sakura and I
were on a date...

dialogues.jp: ま、相手がさくらなら大丈夫だな。
dialogues.en: Well, it's Sakura, it'd be fine.
dialogues.text: Well, it's Sakura, it'd be fine.

dialogues.jp: あの二人、実は結構、仲いいし。
dialogues.en: The two of them seem pretty close too.
dialogues.text: The two of them seem pretty close too.

dialogues.jp: 合宿、さくらも誘ってやればよかった。
dialogues.en: I'm glad Sakura was invited to the training camp too.
dialogues.text: I'm glad Sakura was invited to the training camp too.

dialogues.jp: あ！
dialogues.en: Ah!
dialogues.text: Ah!

dialogues.jp: 忘れてた。
dialogues.en: I totally forgot...
dialogues.text: I totally forgot...

dialogues.jp: 杉並、誘ってないや。しまった……。
dialogues.en: I was supposed to invite Suginami as well. Doh...
dialogues.text: I was supposed to invite Suginami as well. Doh...

dialogues.jp: 男、俺一人じゃん。
dialogues.en: That'd leave me as the only guy.
dialogues.text: That'd leave me as the only guy.

dialogues.jp:
あー。……まあ、細かいこともまだ聞いてない
し、後で条件提示してまとめて誘ってみよう。
dialogues.en:
Ahh~... Well, I don't know the finer details either, so I'd
wait a little while longer to invite him.
dialogues.text:
Ahh~... Well, I don't know the finer details either, so I'd
wait a little while longer to invite him.

dialogues.jp: 明日のこと、環に聞かないとな……。
dialogues.en:
I haven't really heard anything about tomorrow from
Tamaki...
dialogues.text:
I haven't really heard anything about tomorrow from
Tamaki...

dialogues.jp: 様子、見に行くか。
dialogues.en: I'd go see how she's doing.
dialogues.text: I'd go see how she's doing.

dialogues.jp:
学校に行く口実が見つかり、俺は急いで制服に
着替える。
dialogues.en: Since I was going to school, I quickly threw on my uniform.
dialogues.text: Since I was going to school, I quickly threw on my uniform.

dialogues.jp:
『登校するときは制服着用』って、ほんっと面
倒だよな。
dialogues.en:
Even though it's vacation time, wearing casual clothes to
school makes me self-conscious.
dialogues.text:
Even though it's vacation time, wearing casual clothes to
school makes me self-conscious.

dialogues.jp: 休みの日は免除とかにならないのだろうか……。
dialogues.en: Well, no use talking about it.
dialogues.text: Well, no use talking about it.

dialogues.jp: ま、そんなこと言っても仕方ない。
dialogues.en:
I flipped my bag over my shoulder, and headed out of the
house.
dialogues.text:
I flipped my bag over my shoulder, and headed out of the
house.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、靴を履き、家を出た。
dialogues.en:
A quick check of the courtyard showed no one practicing
there.
dialogues.text:
A quick check of the courtyard showed no one practicing
there.

dialogues.jp:
中庭で、お払いの練習でもしているかと思った
が、そこには誰もいなかった。
dialogues.en: The classroom, then.
dialogues.text: The classroom, then.

dialogues.jp: 部室だろうか。
dialogues.en: I headed there, casually opening the door.
dialogues.text: I headed there, casually opening the door.

dialogues.jp: 俺は部室に向かい、ドアを開ける。
dialogues.en:
A unexpected sight lay before me; Tamaki sitting on a chair,
surrounded by the club members.
dialogues.text:
A unexpected sight lay before me; Tamaki sitting on a chair,
surrounded by the club members.

dialogues.jp:
すると、中に椅子に座った環と、環と数人の部
員がいた。
dialogues.en: The tension in the classroom could've been cut with a knife.
dialogues.text: The tension in the classroom could've been cut with a knife.

dialogues.jp: 何となく、部室の中は緊迫感が漂う。
dialogues.en: "Wait a minute, what do you mean by that?"
dialogues.text: "Wait a minute, what do you mean by that?"

dialogues.speaker: 部員１
dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、どういうことですか？」
dialogues.en: She said in a hysterical voice.
dialogues.text: She said in a hysterical voice.

dialogues.jp: ヒステリックな声が響く。
dialogues.en: The club members started to inch closer to her.
dialogues.text: The club members started to inch closer to her.

dialogues.jp: 部員達が環に詰め寄っているようだ。
dialogues.en:
Tamaki though, looked completely exhausted, leaning heavily
on her chair.
dialogues.text:
Tamaki though, looked completely exhausted, leaning heavily
on her chair.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、環はぐったりして、椅子にもたれてい
る。
dialogues.en: What on earth's going on here...
dialogues.text: What on earth's going on here...

dialogues.jp: 何か、あったのかな……。
dialogues.en:
It might not be the best idea for me to get involved in the
Miko Club matters, but...
dialogues.text:
It might not be the best idea for me to get involved in the
Miko Club matters, but...

dialogues.jp:
巫女部の内部のことなので、俺がでしゃばるの
も筋違いかもしれないが……。
dialogues.en: "What happened here?"
dialogues.text: "What happened here?"

dialogues.jp: 「どうかしたのか？」
dialogues.en:
I asked Tamaki and the club members, trying to find the
source of the tense atmosphere.
dialogues.text:
I asked Tamaki and the club members, trying to find the
source of the tense atmosphere.

dialogues.jp:
嫌な雰囲気の原因を探るべく、俺は環と部員に
尋ねる。
dialogues.en:
The club members only seemed to notice my presence when I
spoke up.
dialogues.text:
The club members only seemed to notice my presence when I
spoke up.

dialogues.jp:
部員達はそこで初めて、俺の存在に気づいたら
しい。
dialogues.en: They all looked at me in surprise.
dialogues.text: They all looked at me in surprise.

dialogues.jp: 俺の方を驚いて見る。
dialogues.en: And soon after, fell in silence.
dialogues.text: And soon after, fell in silence.

dialogues.jp: 部員達は、一瞬沈黙する。
dialogues.en: "It's nothing much..."
dialogues.text: "It's nothing much..."

dialogues.speaker: 部員１
dialogues.jp: 「別に、何でも無いですけど……」
dialogues.en: "Looking at this scene, that's hard to believe."
dialogues.text: "Looking at this scene, that's hard to believe."

dialogues.speaker: 部員１
dialogues.jp: 「とても、何でもないようには見えないけど」
dialogues.en: I stood off with them, face to face.
dialogues.text: I stood off with them, face to face.

dialogues.jp: 部員達は互いに顔を見合わせ、控えめに言う。
dialogues.en: "...Chief isn't going to the training camp."
dialogues.text: "...Chief isn't going to the training camp."

dialogues.speaker: 部員２
dialogues.jp: 「……実は、部長が合宿に行けないって」

dialogues.speaker: 部員２
dialogues.en: Tamaki isn't?
dialogues.text: Tamaki isn't?

dialogues.jp: 環が？
dialogues.en: She wanted to go so much...
dialogues.text: She wanted to go so much...

dialogues.jp: この間までは、行くつもりだった筈なのに……。
dialogues.en: She even invited me.
dialogues.text: She even invited me.

dialogues.jp: だから、俺を誘ってくれたんだろう。
dialogues.en: "...I truly apologize... my headaches are getting awful..."
dialogues.text: "...I truly apologize... my headaches are getting awful..."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「……申し訳ありませんが……頭痛がひどいの
　で……」
dialogues.en:
"But without you, there's no training camp. None of us know
anything about Miko..."
dialogues.text:
"But without you, there's no training camp. None of us know
anything about Miko..."

dialogues.speaker: 部員１
dialogues.jp:
「でも、部長がいなかったら合宿にならないで
　すよ。誰も、巫女のことなんか分からないの
　に……」
dialogues.en: The club member retorted to Tamaki.
dialogues.text: The club member retorted to Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 部員が環に食ってかかる。
dialogues.en: "Come on, she said she was having headaches...!"
dialogues.text: "Come on, she said she was having headaches...!"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 1
dialogues.jp:
「ちょっと、部長は、頭痛がするって言ってる
　じゃない……！」

dialogues.speaker: 部員１
dialogues.en: What the first club member said is true.
dialogues.text: What the first club member said is true.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、部員の言うことはもっともだ。
dialogues.en:
This isn't a normal club. A Miko Appreciation Club needs a
Miko to actually head and organize activities.
dialogues.text:
This isn't a normal club. A Miko Appreciation Club needs a
Miko to actually head and organize activities.

dialogues.jp:
普通の部活ならいざ知らず、巫女という特殊な
部になると、巫女自体がいないため、巫女であ
る部長の役割は大きい。
dialogues.en: Tamaki knew that well, herself.
dialogues.text: Tamaki knew that well, herself.

dialogues.jp: それは、環だって分かっているはずだ。
dialogues.en: But today, she looked completely lifeless.
dialogues.text: But today, she looked completely lifeless.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、今日の環は、聞いているのかどうかわ
からないくらい、ぐったりとしている。
dialogues.en:
Her body was limp. Her eyes were vacant. Sweat was forming
on her forehead.
dialogues.text:
Her body was limp. Her eyes were vacant. Sweat was forming
on her forehead.

dialogues.jp: 体力的に相当きついのか、目が虚ろだ。
dialogues.en: No one could've imagined it'd get this bad for her...
dialogues.text: No one could've imagined it'd get this bad for her...

dialogues.jp:
今までに、あんなにつらそうにしていたことは
なかったと思うけれど……。
dialogues.en:
Most of the people here probably didn't know she was going
through so much pain too.
dialogues.text:
Most of the people here probably didn't know she was going
through so much pain too.

dialogues.jp:
知らないうちに、病気がひどくなっていたのだ
ろうか。
dialogues.en: "Hey, Tamaki, are you okay?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, Tamaki, are you okay?"

dialogues.jp: 「おい、環、大丈夫か？」
dialogues.en: She weakly nodded to my question.
dialogues.text: She weakly nodded to my question.

dialogues.jp: 俺の問いかけに、環は黙ってコクリと頷く。
dialogues.en: Screw the training camp, she needs to rest.
dialogues.text: Screw the training camp, she needs to rest.

dialogues.jp: 合宿どころか、休んだ方がいい。
dialogues.en:
And the way Tamaki is right now, she has no strength to even
talk.
dialogues.text:
And the way Tamaki is right now, she has no strength to even
talk.

dialogues.jp: しかし、環に部員を説得する力は無いだろう。
dialogues.en: I'd have to help her out here...
dialogues.text: I'd have to help her out here...

dialogues.jp: ここは、一肌脱ぐか……。
dialogues.en: I turned to face the crowd of club members.
dialogues.text: I turned to face the crowd of club members.

dialogues.jp: 俺は、環に詰め寄る部員達に言う。
dialogues.en: "Unfortunately, the training camp is cancelled."
dialogues.text: "Unfortunately, the training camp is cancelled."

dialogues.jp: 「悪いけど、合宿は中止だ」
dialogues.en: "What!?"
dialogues.text: "What!?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.en:
"Sorry... I know it would've been fun. But surely you can
figure out that Tamaki can't take it?"
dialogues.text:
"Sorry... I know it would've been fun. But surely you can
figure out that Tamaki can't take it?"

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「すまん。楽しみにしてるだろうけど、環がこ
　の状況じゃ無理なのは、わかるだろう？」
dialogues.en: "That's true, but..."
dialogues.text: "That's true, but..."

dialogues.speaker: 部員２
dialogues.jp: 「そうですけど……」
dialogues.en: "Please, just leave it as it is."
dialogues.text: "Please, just leave it as it is."

dialogues.speaker: 部員２
dialogues.jp: 「頼む。この通りだ」
dialogues.en:
I bowed to the club members. They didn't know the situation,
and I didn't know what to do about it.
dialogues.text:
I bowed to the club members. They didn't know the situation,
and I didn't know what to do about it.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、部員達に頭を下げる。彼女たちも状況が
わからないわけではないだろうが、どうしてい
いかわからないのだろう。
dialogues.en:
"Once Tamaki recovers, we'd start re-planning another
training camp. So please accept the decision."
dialogues.text:
"Once Tamaki recovers, we'd start re-planning another
training camp. So please accept the decision."

dialogues.jp: 「環が回復したら、合宿はちゃんと行うから」
dialogues.en: I humbly requested of them, praying that they'd accept.
dialogues.text: I humbly requested of them, praying that they'd accept.

dialogues.jp: 俺は祈るような気持ちで部員に頼む。
dialogues.en:
"But... I cancelled plans with my boyfriend just for the
training camp..."
dialogues.text:
"But... I cancelled plans with my boyfriend just for the
training camp..."

dialogues.speaker: Club Member 2
dialogues.jp:
「でも、あたし……合宿のために、彼氏との予
　定をキャンセルしたんですよ？」
dialogues.en: "Even if Chief can't go, can't someone else take her place?"
dialogues.text: "Even if Chief can't go, can't someone else take her place?"

dialogues.speaker: 部員２
dialogues.jp:
「部長がいけないなら、せめて代理人くらいな
　んとかなりませんか？」
dialogues.en: The club members seemed to want to go at any costs.
dialogues.text: The club members seemed to want to go at any costs.

dialogues.jp:
部員達も、できれば合宿を行いたいと思ってい
るらしい。
dialogues.en: And so do I... but only together with Tamaki.
dialogues.text: And so do I... but only together with Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: それは、俺も、環だって一緒だ。
dialogues.en:
I glanced at Tamaki, and was instantly saddened by her
sorrowful face and weak condition.
dialogues.text:
I glanced at Tamaki, and was instantly saddened by her
sorrowful face and weak condition.

dialogues.jp:
環の方を見ると、すまなそうな顔をしているが
やはり身体は辛そうだ。
dialogues.en: Damnit, this is getting irritating.
dialogues.text: Damnit, this is getting irritating.

dialogues.jp: ったく、無茶言うなっての。
dialogues.en:
I've just about had it with these chatterboxes who know
nothing.
dialogues.text:
I've just about had it with these chatterboxes who know
nothing.

dialogues.jp:
あんまりワガママばかりいうなら、いくら俺だっ
てガマンの限界があるぞ。
dialogues.en: Suddenly, the door of the clubroom flew open.
dialogues.text: Suddenly, the door of the clubroom flew open.

dialogues.jp: 突然、部室のドアが勢いよく開く。
dialogues.en: The action drew the attention of everyone in the room.
dialogues.text: The action drew the attention of everyone in the room.

dialogues.jp: 居合わせたみんなは、ドアに視線を向ける。
dialogues.en: It was the captain of the miracle baseball team.
dialogues.text: It was the captain of the miracle baseball team.

dialogues.jp:
そこには、現在、奇跡の連勝中の野球部の主将
が、仁王立ちで立っていた。
dialogues.en: "Hey!"
dialogues.text: "Hey!"

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「おい！」
dialogues.en: The captain--senpai, yelled out in a low voice.
dialogues.text: The captain--senpai, yelled out in a low voice.

dialogues.jp: 主将は低い声で、
dialogues.en: "What's the meaining of this!"
dialogues.text: "What's the meaining of this!"

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ！」
dialogues.en: He stomped his way into the classroom, threateningly.
dialogues.text: He stomped his way into the classroom, threateningly.

dialogues.jp: と、すごい剣幕で部室へ入る。
dialogues.en:
Both the club members and myself were completely clueless as
to why he was so angry.
dialogues.text:
Both the club members and myself were completely clueless as
to why he was so angry.

dialogues.jp:
俺と部員達は、なぜ主将が怒っているのか分か
らない。
dialogues.en: He stood right in front of the still-seated Tamaki.
dialogues.text: He stood right in front of the still-seated Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: 主将は、椅子に座る環の前に立ち、
dialogues.en: "How can this be? The victory prayer's stopped working!"
dialogues.text: "How can this be? The victory prayer's stopped working!"

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「どういうことだ、必勝祈願、効かなかったぞ」
dialogues.en: He yelled.
dialogues.text: He yelled.

dialogues.jp: と、怒鳴る。
dialogues.en: Tamaki weakly lifted her eyes to match the captain's.
dialogues.text: Tamaki weakly lifted her eyes to match the captain's.

dialogues.jp:
環は、椅子に座ったまま、弱々しい目で主将を
見る。
dialogues.en:
"We've been winning till now, how could this happen? Were
you slacking!?"
dialogues.text:
"We've been winning till now, how could this happen? Were
you slacking!?"

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp:
「今まで、勝ってたのに、どういうことだ。ま
　さか、手を抜いたんじゃ……」
dialogues.en: He started to scold her.
dialogues.text: He started to scold her.

dialogues.jp: と、環をなじる。
dialogues.en: "Wait, senpai! That's not true!"
dialogues.text: "Wait, senpai! That's not true!"

dialogues.jp: 「ちょっと、先輩！　そりゃあ、ないでしょう」
dialogues.en: Without thinking, I jumped between Tamaki and the captain.
dialogues.text: Without thinking, I jumped between Tamaki and the captain.

dialogues.jp: 思わず、俺は先輩に怒鳴りつける。
dialogues.en:
The eternally-losing baseball club who pulled off a miracle
win.. how could he say that!
dialogues.text:
The eternally-losing baseball club who pulled off a miracle
win.. how could he say that!

dialogues.jp:
万年弱小野球部なんて、１回戦に勝てただけで
も奇跡に近いのに、何言ってんだ！
dialogues.en: The two wins after proved it couldn't be a fluke...
dialogues.text: The two wins after proved it couldn't be a fluke...

dialogues.jp: ３回も勝てたことが既にまぐれなのに……。
dialogues.en: "Who the hell are you? Don't get involved."
dialogues.text: "Who the hell are you? Don't get involved."

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp: 「何だお前？　関係ないだろ」
dialogues.en: He glared at me menacingly.
dialogues.text: He glared at me menacingly.

dialogues.jp: 主将にギロリと｛にら／睨｝まれる。
dialogues.en: But I wasn't going to back down either.
dialogues.text: But I wasn't going to back down either.

dialogues.jp: しかし、俺は構わず食って掛かる。
dialogues.en:
"Victory prayers aren't magic! Don't go saying that it's
Tamaki's fault that you lost!"
dialogues.text:
"Victory prayers aren't magic! Don't go saying that it's
Tamaki's fault that you lost!"

dialogues.jp:
「必勝祈願は魔法じゃない！　先輩達が負けた
　理由を、環に押しつけてるだけじゃないです
　か！」
dialogues.en:
"What!? We'd all been training like hell for the final
game!"
dialogues.text:
"What!? We'd all been training like hell for the final
game!"

dialogues.speaker: Captain
dialogues.jp:
「なんだと！　こっちは、決勝をめざして、全
　員猛練習してたんだぞ！」
dialogues.en: He grabbed onto me by the chest.
dialogues.text: He grabbed onto me by the chest.

dialogues.jp: 主将は俺の胸ぐらを掴む。
dialogues.en: "That doesn't mean it's right to blame Tamaki!"
dialogues.text: "That doesn't mean it's right to blame Tamaki!"

dialogues.jp: 俺は、殴られる覚悟を決める。
dialogues.en: I prepared myself for the beating of my life.
dialogues.text: I prepared myself for the beating of my life.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「止めてください……」
dialogues.en: "Please stop..."
dialogues.text: "Please stop..."

dialogues.jp:
まるで、身体の底から搾り出すような声が聞こ
えた。
dialogues.en:
With her body so weak, she still managed to squeeze out a
whisper.
dialogues.text:
With her body so weak, she still managed to squeeze out a
whisper.

dialogues.jp:
それは、すごくか細い声なのに、何故か全員の
耳に届いた。
dialogues.en: It was said so softly, yet the entire room heard it.
dialogues.text: It was said so softly, yet the entire room heard it.

dialogues.en: "......Tamaki."
dialogues.text: "......Tamaki."

dialogues.jp: 思わず、誰もが止まる。
dialogues.en: Everyone stopped what they were doing immediately.
dialogues.text: Everyone stopped what they were doing immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Tamaki
dialogues.jp: 「……ごめんなさい……わたくしのせいで……」
dialogues.en: "...I'm terribly sorry... it is all my fault..."
dialogues.text: "...I'm terribly sorry... it is all my fault..."

dialogues.jp: 環は、ボロボロと涙をこぼす。
dialogues.en: Tamaki started to cry.
dialogues.text: Tamaki started to cry.

dialogues.jp: 主将は、俺の｛えりくび／襟首｝を放す。
dialogues.en: The captain finally released his grip on my collar.
dialogues.text: The captain finally released his grip on my collar.

dialogues.en: "Tamaki..."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki..."

dialogues.jp:
俺は環の肩を抱くが、苦しそうに嗚咽をもらし
ていた。
dialogues.en:
I put my hands on her shoulders, her painful sobs clearly
audible.
dialogues.text:
I put my hands on her shoulders, her painful sobs clearly
audible.

dialogues.jp: このまま、ここにいるのは良くないな。
dialogues.en: She shouldn't stay here any longer.
dialogues.text: She shouldn't stay here any longer.

dialogues.jp:
環の情緒が、ぐらぐらと不安定になっているの
を感じる。
dialogues.en: Her emotions were getting cloudy and unstable.
dialogues.text: Her emotions were getting cloudy and unstable.

dialogues.jp:
体のことや合宿のこと、野球部のことで、受け
止め切れないんだろう。
dialogues.en:
With her body, the training camp, and now the baseball club
all stressing her...
dialogues.text:
With her body, the training camp, and now the baseball club
all stressing her...

dialogues.jp:
環自身、どうしたらいいのか、よくわかってい
ないみたいだし。
dialogues.en: She was completely clueless on what she should do.
dialogues.text: She was completely clueless on what she should do.

dialogues.jp: 俺がもっと、支えてあげられれば……。
dialogues.en: I have to support her better...
dialogues.text: I have to support her better...

dialogues.jp: 「環、休んだ方がいい」
dialogues.en: "Tamaki, just get some rest."
dialogues.text: "Tamaki, just get some rest."

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環を椅子から立ち上がらせ、出口へと促
す。
dialogues.en: I hoisted her from the chair, and helped her to the exit.
dialogues.text: I hoisted her from the chair, and helped her to the exit.

dialogues.jp: そして、黙ってみている部員達に、
dialogues.en: I then turned to the club members, and said,
dialogues.text: I then turned to the club members, and said,

dialogues.jp: 「……悪いが、環はつれて帰る。合宿は中止だ」
dialogues.en:
"...I'm sorry, but Tamaki's going home. The training camp is
cancelled."
dialogues.text:
"...I'm sorry, but Tamaki's going home. The training camp is
cancelled."

dialogues.jp: 部員達が、ごくりと喉を鳴らすのがわかった。
dialogues.en: There wasn't much response except slow breathing.
dialogues.text: There wasn't much response except slow breathing.

dialogues.jp: そして、野球部の主将の方を向く。
dialogues.en: Then, to the baseball club captain,
dialogues.text: Then, to the baseball club captain,

dialogues.jp:
「先輩。環のおかげで、３回戦までいけたんじゃ
　ないんですか？　感謝こそすれ、責任を押し
　つけるのは、カッコ悪いッスよ」
dialogues.en:
"Senpai. It's thanks to Tamaki that you won 3 games in a
row. You should be thanking her."
dialogues.text:
"Senpai. It's thanks to Tamaki that you won 3 games in a
row. You should be thanking her."

dialogues.jp:
先輩は、何も言えずに、やり場を失った拳を
ぎゅっと握っていた。
dialogues.en:
He didn't say anything, and seemed to have lost his anger,
but still balled his hand into a fist.
dialogues.text:
He didn't say anything, and seemed to have lost his anger,
but still balled his hand into a fist.

dialogues.jp: そりゃあ、悔しいのはわかるけどさ……。
dialogues.en: I can understand his regret, but still...
dialogues.text: I can understand his regret, but still...

dialogues.jp: 俺は、もう一度、部室を見回して、背を向ける。
dialogues.en: I gave the clubroom a last look-over, then headed out.
dialogues.text: I gave the clubroom a last look-over, then headed out.

dialogues.jp: 部員のことを考えれば、無責任な行動だと思う。
dialogues.en:
I might've been a bit irresponsible dealing with the club
members...
dialogues.text:
I might've been a bit irresponsible dealing with the club
members...

dialogues.jp:
結局、フォローもなく合宿中止じゃ、部員達は
納得できないだろう。
dialogues.en:
In the end, they still didn't seem to accept that the
training camp was cancelled.
dialogues.text:
In the end, they still didn't seem to accept that the
training camp was cancelled.

dialogues.jp: 悪いと思っていながらも。
dialogues.en: They probably think worse of me, but regardless.
dialogues.text: They probably think worse of me, but regardless.

dialogues.jp:
俺は環を支えてやろうと思うことで、精一杯だっ
た。
dialogues.en: I'd do anything to make sure Tamaki's safe.
dialogues.text: I'd do anything to make sure Tamaki's safe.

dialogues.jp: 誰が悪い訳じゃあない。もちろん環だって。
dialogues.en: It's not a case of who's wrong. It's all for Tamaki.
dialogues.text: It's not a case of who's wrong. It's all for Tamaki.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、まだぐったりしている環を神社まで送り
届けた。
dialogues.en: I continued towards the shrine, supporting the woozy Tamaki.
dialogues.text: I continued towards the shrine, supporting the woozy Tamaki.

dialogues.jp: ◆合宿が中止に◆
dialogues.en: ◆Training Camp Cancelled?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Training Camp Cancelled?◆

dialogues.jp: 巫女部の合宿の前日、環が部員達ともめていた。
dialogues.en:
The day before the Miko Club training camp, Tamaki and the
club members fell into a dispute.
dialogues.text:
The day before the Miko Club training camp, Tamaki and the
club members fell into a dispute.

dialogues.jp:
理由は、環の体調不良により、合宿が取りやめ
になることだった。
dialogues.en:
This was due to Tamaki wanting to cancel the training camp,
due to her failing health.
dialogues.text:
This was due to Tamaki wanting to cancel the training camp,
due to her failing health.

dialogues.jp:
そこへ、野球部の主将も、試合に負けたことを
環に責めたため、環は泣き出してしまった。
dialogues.en:
Soon after came the Baseball Club captain, blaming Tamaki
for their recent loss, and making her cry.
dialogues.text:
Soon after came the Baseball Club captain, blaming Tamaki
for their recent loss, and making her cry.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、環を落ち着かせるために、部室の外へ連
れ出し、神社へと送っていった。
dialogues.en:
I led her out of the room and back to the shrine, trying to
calm her down.
dialogues.text:
I led her out of the room and back to the shrine, trying to
calm her down.

dialogues.jp: 何があっても、俺が環を支えてやならくちゃ。
dialogues.en: What happens, I'd always be there for her.
dialogues.text: What happens, I'd always be there for her.
